description: For a complete consistent set \(S\), if \(t_i\sim u_i\) for every \(i<k\), then \(R(t_0,\ldots,t_{k-1})\in S\) if and only if \(R(u_0,\ldots,u_{k-1})\in S\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.relation_congruence.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {S : Set (L.Formula ℕ)} (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S) {k : ℕ} (r : L.Relations k)
  (ts us : Fin k → L.Term ℕ)
  (h : ∀ (i : Fin k), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.TermEquivalent S (ts i) (us i)) :
  r.formula ts ∈ S ↔ r.formula us ∈ S
